How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders take 1 to 2 business days to process before shipping. Standard Priority Ground shipping takes 5 to 7 business days via DHL with final delivery by USPS.
Once your order finishes processing and ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with your tracking details! Is there anything else I can help you with?

Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Carrier transit time for standard Continental United States Priority Ground is 5 to 7 business days. We also offer 3-Day Air (3 business days), 2-Day Air (2 business days), and Overnight shipping (1 business day).
Please note that shipping times represent transit time after the 1 to 2 business days required for order processing. Is there anything else I can help you with?
